INTRODUCTION Blank detail specification A blank detail specification is a supplementary document to the Sectional Specification and contains requirements for style and layout and minimum content of detail specifications. Detail specifications not complying with these requirements may not be considered as being in accordance with I EC specifications nor shall they so be described. In the preparation of detail specifications specification shall be taken into account. the content of Sub-clause 1.4 of the sectional which
